notes.title: Announcing Tamer Town
notes.content: [p]As we've previously mentioned, we’ve made the difficult decision to [b]discontinue development on Anitons[/b]. It wasn’t easy to let go of a project we—and many of you—put so much heart into. Your support meant the world to us throughout Anitons’ journey. ❤️[/p][p]But today, we’re thrilled to finally share what comes next. 🎉[/p][p]We’ve taken everything we've learned, stayed true to our creative DNA, and are now working on a brand new monster-taming experience: [b]Tamer Town[/b]![/p][p]👾 [b]Tamer Town[/b] is a cozy, strategic [b]monster-tamer city-builder[/b] where you raise creatures, battle rivals, and develop a growing town full of quirky characters and wild adventures. It’s everything we love—monsters, community, and meaningful progression—wrapped in a fresh new vision.[/p][p]👉 [b]Check out Tamer Town on Steam and wishlist it here[/b]: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3601860/Tamer_Town/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thank you for sticking with us. We can’t wait to show you more of Tamer Town very soon. Let the taming begin! 🏘️✨[/p][p]— The Crazy Goat Games Team[/p]

notes.title: Kickstarter campaign launches on the 8th of November!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers! 

We are STILL indeed hard at work on developing our game, maybe even too hard. 
But! We have good news: 

[b]Anitons' Kickstarter campaign is launching on the 8th of November! [/b]

If you still haven't followed it, be sure to do it now to get notified once it goes live. 

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/anitonsrelaunch/anitons-open-world-monster-collecting-and-farming-game

On the campaign page, you'll be able to find out more about our project. We've also prepared various exclusive, one-of-a-kind rewards for possible supporters! They’re madly awesome, seriously! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39430525/0c30b4cf2fa0db375e6c28b91a892f4463b89911.gif[/img]

Also, we were able to work on the second part of the Anitons Demo continuing from the last one! Please check it out whether it’s your first or second time experiencing the world of these amazing monsters. The Demo will be available along with the Kickstarter campaign's launch. Be the first to see all the improvements and new features and maybe it'll convince you to join Anitons in the long run! We still need all possible help to bring this world to life. 

We deeply thank everyone who has supported the Anitons development journey in any way, even the smallest, as well as those who just now tune in for this adventure. You’ll definitely enjoy yourself here! We hope to catch your heart with our project which is so full of passion and love. Hopefully, Anitons makes you fall in love with its amazing world as well! 
Remember to check out the entire Kickstarter campaign on the 8th! 

Consider joining our Discord server where you can enjoy the ever-growing community, talk to us or simply follow the updates from a close source. 

https://discord.gg/gqegwzHQxF

The long but exciting journey is in full swing! ❤️🐐

notes.title: Our Kickstarter Coming-Soon Page and Demo are Live!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello adventurers![/h3]

As you have probably figured out, we are still hard at work developing the game.
However, we feel comfortable enough with Anitons that we've decided to take it to the next step and release a [url=https://bit.ly/3vf6JeM]Kickstarter Coming-Soon page for it![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39430525/2af15cd48755149466743b5f1dca27ac5c0b06a6.png[/img]

There, you can follow us to receive a notification when the proper campaign goes out. By following our Coming-Soon page, you are helping us spread the awareness of Anitons to other people, and by that - create an even more awesome community for the game. Please go and check it out!
We also plan on doing customary "Early Bird" packs, so you can grab an early discount. It's on us!

... but that's not the end of the news!

While the game is still in heavy development, with the help of the funds we've previously secured, we were able to work on a demo for the game! 
 
The first demo is live as you read the post. There, you will have a chance to experience a very early introduction to the world of Anitons. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39430525/643b6dd95ccf44b8e24fd8bb1d6c27d1ac0c6525.gif[/img]

The second demo will come out along with the launch of our full-on proper Kickstarter campaign, so stay put! It will be a continuation of the previous demo. While the funds we've previously secured were enough to prepare the two demos, we still need your help in bringing Anitons to life.

We would like to thank everyone who has shown their support throughout this amazing journey. We hope those little demos will show just how much love we’ve put into this project and that you will enjoy it too. Again - go and check out our Coming-Soon page!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39430525/0c30b4cf2fa0db375e6c28b91a892f4463b89911.gif[/img]

If you want to become a part of an ever-growing community of Anitons fans, check out our [url=https://bit.ly/3azUOkJ]Discord server[/url]! There, you can talk about the project all you want, find out the newest updates on the game, and even talk to the devs directly! 
 
Meanwhile, keep your heads up for future updates on the game. There’s more to come!
 
Stay put! ❤️🐐
